supportedStateAccess.contract: State made by its model; public scoped mutable view permits initialization; no buffer access while prediction in flight; no pointer may escape closure. Same schema alone does not establish cross-model object sharing.
supportedStateAccess.existingProduction: prefillModel.makeState reused by corresponding decode model; this does not establish Q8-state/Q4-object portability
supportedStateAccess.possibleBridge: model-owned Q4 state initialized via documented mutable views with exact completed Q8 prefill FP16 values, only if actual runtime layout/value checks and semantic parity prove validity; NOT IMPLEMENTED while Level A unresolved

physicalBridgeResult.method: Q4 decode.makeState, two nested public withMultiArray closures, copy after completed Q8 prefill
physicalBridgeResult.scope: synthetic legitimate Q8 prefill -> public scoped byte-exact FP16 initialization of Q4-owned state; one diagnostic decode, NOT public synthesis
physicalBridgeResult.unproven: Frozen reference/public generation state bridge, long decode/parity/audio not tested; no production bridge implemented
